item.title: How do I make sure I get my rental deposit back in Sweden?
item.description: Paying a deposit is a normal part of the rental process in Sweden, but getting it back at the end of your tenancy can occasionally prove tricky.

item.title: Today in Sweden: A roundup of the latest news on Monday
item.description: Immigrants increasingly important for welfare, Swedish forecaster warns of heavy winds, and other news from Sweden on Monday.

item.title: Immigrants now make up more than half of Sweden's nursing assistants
item.description: A new report by the Swedish Association of Local Authorities and Regions (SALAR) has highlighted the growing role of immigrant workers in delivering health and other welfare services, with more than half of all nursing assistants being immigrants.

item.title: 'United States cannot replace Europe': EU hits back at US and Musk
item.description: The European Union was forced to defend itself on Monday after Washington criticised the bloc's policies and in a separate swipe the billionaire Elon Musk blew his top saying the EU should be abolished.

item.title: 'Feeling of belonging is fading': The verdict on life in Sweden in 2026
item.description: Readers of The Local Sweden are fairly upbeat about the year ahead, with many expecting an economic rebound, better personal finances and even a pause in Sweden’s migration clampdown. Although the election is causing concern for many.

item.title: Swedish word of the day: slut
item.description: We know what you're thinking and no, that's not what this word means. So, where are trains really going when they're heading for the slutstation?

item.title: How to bring your pet to Sweden
item.description: With ample green spaces and welcoming cafes, Sweden is one of the most dog-friendly countries in the world. If you want to move with your furry family members, here’s what you need to do to get them to Sweden.

item.title: Six mistakes to avoid when buying an apartment in Sweden
item.description: Buying a home is often a complicated process in any country. Here are some of the pitfalls to avoid in Sweden.

item.title: European countries agree to set up migrant 'return hubs' outside EU
item.description: EU countries on Monday backed a significant tightening of Europe's immigration policy, including endorsing the concept of setting up "return hubs" outside the 27-nation bloc for failed asylum-seekers.

item.title: TELL US: Americans in Europe, would you give up US citizenship to be European?
item.description: After a US Senator sparked uproar by introducing a bill that would eliminate the possibility of dual citizenship for American citizens, we want to hear from US nationals in Europe. Would you give up your US passport to be European?
